mapper.select:
SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, ancestors, org_name AS orgName, org_code AS orgCode, leader, phone, email, sort_order AS sort, status, created_at AS createdAt, created_at AS createTime FROM sys_org
deleted = 0
AND org_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orgName}, '%')
ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_org (parent_id, ancestors, org_name, org_code, leader, phone, email, sort_order, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{ancestors}, #{orgName}, #{orgCode}, #{leader}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
